result.brief: 提出几何引导的注意力剪枝框架，将预训练视频扩散Transformer的自注意力改造为相机控制与长时序场景记忆的统一机制，无需额外可学习模块即可提升相机遵循与重访一致性并大幅加速推理。
result.reason: Geometry-guided attention pruning in pretrained video diffusion transformers for camera control and long-horizon scene memory, directly serving long video controllable generation.
